passages.note: Bill status page lists Ortiz as a co-sponsor of HB2721, a single-subject middle-housing zoning deregulation bill signed into law.

passages.provision_quote: a municipality with a population of seventy-five thousand persons or more must authorize by ordinance and incorporate into its development regulations, zoning regulations and other official controls the development of duplexes, triplexes, fourplexes and townhomes as a permitted use
passages.note: Chapter 197 text mandates municipalities permit middle housing by right and bars restrictions on it beyond those applied to single-family zoning.
House Final Reading roll call shows Ortiz voting Yes on HB2721, which passed 42-15-3-0-0.

rows.reasoning: As a State Representative, Ortiz co-sponsored HB 2721 (2024) and voted Yes on final passage (ORTIZ Y, Passed 42-15-3-0-0); signed into Chapter 197, the single-subject bill bars municipalities from restricting duplexes, triplexes, fourplexes and townhomes beyond single-family zoning rules and requires they be a permitted use, which cuts the zoning limits that block private building of that housing, matching rung 5 ('at most, cut the regulations and zoning limits that block private building'). Her House-years record counts for her current Senate seat under the same-legislature rule.
